**《中国青年报》在3月19日的头版刊发了对云遥宇航创始人兼董事长李峰辉的专访。**

3月17日16时7分，酒泉卫星发射中心，谷神星一号遥十运载火箭飞向太空，将8颗卫星送入太阳同步轨道，其中6颗是来自天津云遥宇航科技有限公司的气象空间遥感卫星。

“截至目前，我们已经发射了40颗卫星。”云遥宇航创始人、董事长李峰辉告诉记者，“本周五还将再发射6颗卫星，一周12颗，这个纪录是史无前例的。”

这家年轻的企业做了许多刷新纪录的事。它是我国第一家，也是目前唯一一家商业气象卫星全链条服务商。6年前，31岁的李峰辉把探索星空的雄心写进“云遥星座计划”，按照他的设想，要在距地球表面500公里至800公里的轨道上，发射90颗气象小卫星，完成全球组网星座计划。

这意味着，从此中国人可以拥有自己的全球商业气象数据，打造出气象界的“北斗系统”，打破国外技术垄断。

![](/media/news/mtImg2_260402180510A175.webp)

![](/media/news/yyImg12_260402180527A176.webp)


**把商用卫星变小 成本降低**

李峰辉曾就职于中国空间技术研究院，长期从事卫星领域研究工作，参与过40多颗卫星的研制工作。他很清楚行业发展的痛点和短板——因为国产卫星少，我国气象数据国产化程度低，常常受制于人。

眼看着国外商用卫星一颗颗发射升空，李峰辉有一种时不我待的紧迫感。2019年还在天津大学读博士时，他就创办了云遥宇航。很快，一支年轻的科研团队集结完毕，核心成员由从事航天科研的资深设计师、气象行业专家等组成。

低成本、高效益，是他们选择的一条卫星商业化之路。李峰辉说，在太空中，多一分重量意味着要付出更高昂的成本，于是研发团队在卫星小型化的技术细节上，做了大量技术更新和迭代。

航天技术从来不是一蹴而就的，每一个细节都要经过很长时间的磨合和验证，“要想方设法做得更好一些，就不得不付出更多的努力。”李峰辉说，“现在我们的产品能做到两公斤左右”。

在位于天津港保税区的云遥宇航公司展厅内，陈列着大大小小的人造气象卫星。它们升入太空后，将成为真正的“千里眼”，当“云遥气象星座”中的“千里眼”越来越多，它们的视线将覆盖全球各个角落。那时，人们可以更加清楚地了解地球每时每刻的“情绪变化”，天气预报能精确到20分钟级。

此前，因为没有自主研发的全球远洋气象导航系统，中国远洋船舶都不得不使用国外公司的气象导航服务，不仅每年要支付几十亿元的服务费，还不得不将船舶技术资料、船舶动态信息提供给对方，对国家安全构成潜在威胁。针对这些情况，云遥宇航研发了全球远洋气象导航系统，2024年6月上线，已经服务了超过300航次。

**打造气象界的“北斗系统”**

“云遥星座计划”正在打破这种“卡脖子”的局面。李峰辉说，“我们一定要从数据源头实现国产化”。他希望通过全球组网，建立一个集全球空间气象数据生产及空间气象数据应用于一体的综合服务平台，生产中国人自己的气象数据。

显示屏上跳动的数字，就是正在地球头顶“奔跑”着的卫星们发回来的。它们的速度非常快，每90分钟就能绕地球一周。每颗卫星上都搭载着“神秘盒子”，那就是云遥GNSS掩星探测载荷，对于天气预报、全球气候变化和地震预报等具有重要价值。

李峰辉解释说，“掩星”的概念来源于天文学，指的是一个天体被另一个天体遮掩的天文现象。科学家们利用自然界的掩星事件，对地球的电离层和中性大气进行测量。当运行中的低轨卫星逐渐远离或接近一颗导航卫星时，后者发出的导航信号，恰好穿过大气层且被前者的掩星天线接收，就发生了一次GNSS掩星事件。

然而，当导航卫星发射的信号穿越大气层后，探测载荷容易出现信号衰减严重、抖动剧烈等技术问题，为此云遥宇航团队又进一步提出了星载掩星事件预报、临边信号开环跟踪算法，使得大气掩星跟踪数量每天增加150条廓线以上，提升了20%的捕获截至角度值。

2024年，云遥气象星座一期12颗卫星已进入中国气象局综合气象观测系统并实现业务运行。这是商业小卫星数据首次获准进入中国气象局业务系统，为我国气象预报预测提供了有力支持。目前，云遥气象星座一期系列卫星每日向中国气象局提供约1.5万条掩星廓线产品，有效提升了风云气象卫星在掩星探测方面的时空分辨率。

**青年创业者找到人生“北斗”**

在打造气象界“北斗导航系统”的征程中，这群年轻科研人员也找到了自己人生的“北斗”。李峰辉透露，除了90颗小卫星，云遥宇航还规划了24颗大卫星，增加了多种探测载荷，探测数据更丰富。

“首发大卫星，预计在今年年底发射。”李峰辉说，在这张即将绘就的蓝图里，未来1-2年内，24颗和风云气象卫星一样大小的卫星，再加上90颗小卫星，“产能会超过美国和欧洲之和”。他认为，到那时，中国在全球气象数据源领域，“是可以和国际领先国家掰掰腕子了！”

创业这几年，李峰辉觉得自己赶上了好时候。国家的快速发展给创业者不断带来新机会。他算了一笔账：2021年打一颗卫星，每公斤费用是15万元，“今年只要7万元一公斤，明年还要降”。降价的背后，是整个产业链的综合发展带动成本下降。李峰辉注意到，随着国家支持力度的加大，整个行业越来越欣欣向荣，大家都乐意去做研发。与此同时，云遥宇航落户的天津港保税区给他们提供了一系列支持政策，团天津市滨海新区区委也积极为这些年轻人解决创业就业的后顾之忧。

几天前，天津市工业和信息化局召开制造业民营企业座谈会，听取民营企业家的意见建议。李峰辉作为10家民营企业代表之一发言。天津市工业和信息化局局长尹继辉表示，要就企业的问题逐一回应解决，不能马上解决的要建立台账，后续专项对接，全力支持民营企业放开手脚搞经营、心无旁骛谋发展。

这些年，李峰辉因为发射卫星被越来越多人熟知，不少人喜欢称这个雄心壮志的年轻人是“天津马斯克”。听到这个称呼，李峰辉笑了，连连摆手说：“我还差得远。”他顿了顿，又说，“但这件事，总要有人去做”。

Exclusive interview on the front page of China Youth Daily with Li Fenghui, the chairman of Yunyao Aerospace Company

**On the front page of March 19th, China Youth Daily published an exclusive interview with Li Fenghui, the founder and chairman of Yunyao Aerospace.**

At 16:07 on March 17th, at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, the Gusheng-1 Y10 carrier rocket flew into space, sending 8 satellites into sun synchronous orbit, including 6 meteorological space remote sensing satellites from Tianjin Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd.

As of now, we have launched 40 satellites, "Li Fenghui, founder and chairman of Yunyao Aerospace, told reporters." We will launch another 6 satellites this Friday, 12 satellites a week, which is an unprecedented record.

This young enterprise has done many record breaking things. It is the first and currently the only commercial meteorological satellite full chain service provider in China. Six years ago, 31 year old Li Fenghui wrote his ambition to explore the stars into the "Cloud Remote Constellation Plan". According to his plan, he wanted to launch 90 meteorological small satellites in an orbit 500 to 800 kilometers above the Earth's surface to complete the global network constellation plan.

This means that from now on, Chinese people can have their own global commercial meteorological data, create the "Beidou system" in the meteorological industry, and break the monopoly of foreign technology.

![](/media/news/mtImg2_260402184812A003.webp)

![](/media/news/yyImg12_260402184838A004.webp)

**Reduce the size of commercial satellites to lower costs**

Li Fenghui used to work at the China Academy of Space Technology and has been engaged in satellite research for a long time, participating in the development of more than 40 satellites. He is well aware of the pain points and shortcomings in the development of the industry - due to the scarcity of domestically produced satellites, the degree of localization of meteorological data in our country is low, and we are often at the mercy of others.

Watching foreign commercial satellites launch into space one by one, Li Fenghui felt a sense of urgency that time waits for no one. In 2019, while still pursuing his PhD at Tianjin University, he founded Yunyao Aerospace. Quickly, a young research team was assembled, consisting of senior designers engaged in aerospace research, meteorological industry experts, and other core members.

Low cost and high efficiency are the paths they have chosen for satellite commercialization. Li Fenghui said that in space, having more weight means paying higher costs, so the R&D team has made a lot of technological updates and iterations on the technical details of satellite miniaturization.

Aerospace technology is never achieved overnight, and every detail needs to go through a long period of adaptation and verification. "To do better, we have to put in more effort," said Li Fenghui. "Now our products can reach about two kilograms.

In the exhibition hall of Yunyao Aerospace Company located in Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone, artificial meteorological satellites of various sizes are displayed. After they ascend into space, they will become true "thousand mile eyes". As more and more "thousand mile eyes" appear in the "cloud remote weather constellations", their vision will cover every corner of the world. At that time, people could have a clearer understanding of the "emotional changes" on Earth at every moment, and weather forecasts could be accurate to the level of 20 minutes.

Previously, due to the lack of independently developed global ocean meteorological navigation systems, Chinese ocean going vessels had to use meteorological navigation services from foreign companies. They not only had to pay billions of yuan in service fees every year, but also had to provide ship technical data and dynamic information to their counterparts, posing a potential threat to national security. In response to these situations, Yunyao Aerospace has developed a global ocean weather navigation system, which will be launched in June 2024 and has served over 300 voyages.

**Building the 'Beidou System' for the meteorological industry**

The Cloud Remote Constellation Program is breaking this bottleneck situation. Li Fenghui said, 'We must achieve localization from the data source.'. He hopes to establish a comprehensive service platform that integrates global space weather data production and space weather data application through global networking, producing Chinese people's own weather data.

The numbers jumping on the display screen are sent back by the satellites running overhead on Earth. Their speed is very fast, they can orbit the Earth once every 90 minutes. Each satellite is equipped with a "mysterious box", which is the cloud remote GNSS occultation detection payload, which has important value for weather forecasting, global climate change, and earthquake prediction.

Li Fenghui explained that the concept of "occultation" originated from astronomy, referring to the astronomical phenomenon where one celestial body is obscured by another. Scientists use natural occultation events to measure the Earth's ionosphere and neutral atmosphere. When a low orbit satellite in operation gradually moves away from or approaches a navigation satellite, and the navigation signal emitted by the latter passes through the atmosphere and is received by the occultation antenna of the former, a GNSS occultation event occurs.

However, when the signals emitted by navigation satellites pass through the atmosphere, the detection payload is prone to technical problems such as severe signal attenuation and severe jitter. Therefore, the Yunyao Aerospace team further proposed satellite based occultation event prediction and edge signal open-loop tracking algorithms, which increased the number of atmospheric occultation tracking profiles by more than 150 per day and improved the capture cut-off angle value by 20%.

In 2024, the first phase of the Yunyao Meteorological Constellation, consisting of 12 satellites, has entered the comprehensive meteorological observation system of the China Meteorological Administration and achieved operational operation. This is the first time that commercial small satellite data has been approved to enter the operational system of the China Meteorological Administration, providing strong support for meteorological forecasting and prediction in China. At present, the first phase of the Yunyao Meteorological Constellation series satellites provide about 15000 occultation profile products to the China Meteorological Administration daily, effectively improving the spatiotemporal resolution of Fengyun Meteorological Satellites in occultation detection.

**Young entrepreneurs find the "Big Dipper" of life**

In the journey of building the "Beidou Navigation System" in the meteorological industry, these young researchers have also found their own "Beidou" in life. Li Fenghui revealed that in addition to 90 small satellites, Yunyao Aerospace has also planned 24 large satellites, adding various detection payloads and richer detection data.

The first large satellite is expected to be launched by the end of this year, "said Li Fenghui. In this upcoming blueprint, within the next 1-2 years, 24 satellites of the same size as Fengyun Meteorological Satellite, plus 90 small satellites," the production capacity will exceed the sum of the United States and Europe. He believes that by then, China will be able to compete with leading international countries in the field of global meteorological data sources.

In the past few years of entrepreneurship, Li Fenghui feels that he has caught a good time. The rapid development of the country constantly brings new opportunities for entrepreneurs. He calculated that the cost of launching a satellite in 2021 would be 150000 yuan per kilogram, but this year it would only cost 70000 yuan per kilogram, and next year it would have to be reduced. Behind the price reduction is the comprehensive development of the entire industry chain driving cost reduction. Li Fenghui noticed that with the increase of national support, the entire industry is becoming more and more prosperous, and everyone is willing to do research and development. At the same time, the Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone where Yunyao Aerospace settled has provided them with a series of support policies, and the Tianjin Binhai New Area District Committee has also actively addressed the concerns of these young people about entrepreneurship and employment.

A few days ago, the Tianjin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology held a symposium for private manufacturing enterprises to listen to the opinions and suggestions of private entrepreneurs. Li Fenghui spoke as one of the representatives of 10 private enterprises. Yin Jihui, Director of the Tianjin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, stated that it is necessary to respond to and solve the problems of enterprises one by one. For those that cannot be solved immediately, a ledger should be established, and special follow-up should be carried out to fully support private enterprises to operate freely and focus on development.

In recent years, Li Fenghui has become increasingly well-known for launching satellites, and many people like to call this ambitious young man "Tianjin Musk". Upon hearing this address, Li Fenghui smiled and waved his hand repeatedly, saying, "I still have a long way to go." He paused before saying, "But someone must do this.
